name: Cashmere Blend Turtleneck — Piacenza
description: A premium cashmere-blend turtleneck from Piacenza — the kind of piece that holds its shape through seasons. Soft texture, clean lines, and a price point that justifies itself over years, not months.

name: Stretch Canvas J06 Pants — Emporio Armani
description: Stretch canvas with the structure of formalwear and the ease of casual pants. Armani's J06 line is engineered for movement — designed for people who don't sit still.

name: Croydon Tote Bag — Mulberry
description: The Croydon tote reimagined in luxurious Italian leather. Structured silhouette with signature Mallory hardware. Spacious interior with internal slip pocket and key chain.

name: Luna Printed Dress — Self-Portrait
description: An ethereal printed chiffon dress with delicate ruffled detailing at the neckline. The Luna dress captures modern romance through fluid silhouette and hand-painted floral motifs.

name: Wool Silk Blazer — Loro Piana
description: Unstructured wool-silk blazer from Loro Piana's core collection. Lightweight with natural stretch, impeccable drape, and the quiet luxury the brand is known for.

name: Leather Biker Jacket — Balmain
description: Signature Balmain biker in buttery lambskin. Quilted shoulders, zippered cuffs, and the iconic gold hardware. Investment piece that defines edgy elegance.

name: Cashmere Scarf — Brunello Cucinelli
description: Ultra-fine cashmere scarf in neutral tones. Hand-finished edges, subtle monili bead detailing. The everyday luxury accessory that elevates any coat.

name: Silk Blend Shirt — Tom Ford
description: Lustrous silk-blend shirt with mother-of-pearl buttons. Tailored fit, spread collar, and the precise construction Tom Ford is renowned for.

name: Pleated Midi Skirt — Max Mara
description: Sharp knife pleats in lightweight wool crepe. Elasticated waist, midi length, and Max Mara's signature clean lines. Versatile from office to evening.

name: Down Puffer Vest — Moncler
description: Iconic Moncler puffer vest in high-fill-power down. Water-repellent shell, logo patch, packable into its own pocket. Lightweight warmth without bulk.

name: Leather Loafers — Tod's
description: Classic Tod's Gommino driving loafer in supple calfskin. 133 rubber pebbles on sole, hand-stitched upper. The epitome of Italian sprezzatura.

name: Wool Coat — The Row
description: Double-faced wool coat with architectural silhouette. Hidden placket, wide lapels, and The Row's obsession with perfect proportions. Heirloom quality.

name: Sunglasses — Jacques Marie Mage
description: Limited-edition acetate frames with titanium core. Custom Zeiss lenses, sterling silver hardware. Numbered production — collectible eyewear.

name: Cashmere Beanie — Eric Javits
description: Rib-knit cashmere beanie with subtle logo patch. Unisex fit, substantial weight, and the softness only Grade A cashmere delivers.

name: Trench Coat — Burberry
description: Heritage cotton gabardine trench with Burberry check lining. Storm shield, epaulettes, belted waist. The original icon, still made in England.

name: Silk Pocket Square — Drake's
description: Hand-rolled edges, exclusive prints from Drake's London archive. Pure silk twill. The finishing touch that separates good from great.

name: Merino Polo — John Smedley
description: 24-gauge Sea Island cotton-merino blend. Fully fashioned construction, zero seams. The polo elevated to its purest form since 1784.

name: Leather Belt — Bottega Veneta
description: Intrecciato woven leather belt in rich tones. Palladium buckle, made in Italy. Quiet luxury at its most tangible — no logo needed.

name: Wool Trousers — Incotex
description: Sartorial wool trousers with split waistband, side adjusters, and unhemmed length for custom tailoring. The gold standard in Italian trousers.

name: Cashmere Cardigan — Alanui
description: Oversized jacquard cashmere cardigan with signature belt. Hand-finished fringes, icon patterns. Wearable art from the Italian sibling duo.
